tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground of the panel. Text on it: text, text-soft, text-muted (all 7:1 or more). Also the well behind inputs, rows and the progress track.

tokens.name: bg-landing
tokens.usage: Ground of the entry (login) screen only. One step lighter than bg; do not mix the two on one screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, menus, toasts. Text on it: text, text-soft, text-muted.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed ground for surface; avatar and chip ground. Text on it: text, text-muted (6.5:1).

tokens.name: surface-dock
tokens.usage: Floating dock pill. Always paired with a 24px backdrop blur and shadow-dock so content scrolling under it stays legible.

tokens.name: surface-header
tokens.usage: Sticky 52px context header. Paired with a 16px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, with a 4px blur.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between a surface and its ground, and between rows. Decorative: never the only cue that a control is a control (use border-control for that).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Row hover outline.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Outline of floating layers (modal, menu, toast, progress capsule) and of a hovered or focused field.

tokens.name: border-landing
tokens.usage: Divider under the entry CTA on the entry screen.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: ADDED, not in the source. Outline of inputs, selects, checkboxes and the toggle track so the control boundary reaches 3:1 on bg and surface (the source border does not). Use on every form control.

tokens.name: fill-subtle
tokens.usage: Session badge and quiet chip ground.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of dock links, ghost buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: fill-active
tokens.usage: Active dock link ground.

tokens.name: fill-active-strong
tokens.usage: Active ground of a pill-nav segment, where the track is darker than the dock.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-hover and surface-dock.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Field labels, menu items and tag text on surface and bg (9:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, inactive nav, placeholders on bg, surface and surface-hover (6.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-landing
tokens.usage: Headline on the entry screen (bg-landing).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative separators only (the slash in the breadcrumb). Never text that carries meaning.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (white button). Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: discord-500
tokens.usage: Discord brand blue. The entry-screen sign-in button fill only. White text on it is 4.6:1.

tokens.name: discord-600
tokens.usage: Discord action fill inside the app (connect, sign in, selected checkbox, unread dot, avatar fallback). White text on it is 6.4:1. Hover state of discord-500.

tokens.name: discord-700
tokens.usage: Pressed state of discord-500 and hover state of discord-600.

tokens.name: on-discord
tokens.usage: Text and icons on discord-500, discord-600, discord-700.

tokens.name: discord-ink
tokens.usage: Blue-tinted text on bg-landing and bg: the pillar index. 7.8:1.

tokens.name: discord-wash-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected row.

tokens.name: discord-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of the batch action bar.

tokens.name: discord-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the batch action bar.

tokens.name: discord-line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of a selected row.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Connected, protected, on. Toggle track when on, session dot, progress fill. Never text on bg (use green-ink).

tokens.name: green-ink
tokens.usage: Success text on green-wash, surface and bg (9:1).

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a success tag.

tokens.name: green-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a success tag and of the connected session badge.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Pending or needs attention. Fill or icon only; text uses amber-ink.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on amber-wash, surface and bg (10:1).

tokens.name: amber-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning tag (message request).

tokens.name: amber-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning tag.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Destructive. Hover color of a chip's remove button. Fill or icon only; text uses red-ink.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Destructive text on red-wash, surface and bg (6.3:1).

tokens.name: red-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a danger button; hover ground of a danger menu item at 0.15.

tokens.name: red-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a danger button.

tokens.name: dc-neutral
tokens.usage: Discord embed and container neutral (0x2B2D31): panels, lists, anything without a state. Matches Discord's dark message ground, so it reads as no stripe.

tokens.name: dc-panel
tokens.usage: Accent stripe of the persistent Components V2 panel and the About view (0x531B37). The only burgundy in the system; it has no web counterpart.

tokens.name: dc-ok
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: completed, protection on, mode active.

tokens.name: dc-warn
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: in progress, partial, attention.

tokens.name: dc-partial
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: cancelled or finished with a remainder.

tokens.name: dc-danger
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: aborted, failed, disconnected.

tokens.name: dc-info
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: informational lists (friends, DM list, tracker).

tokens.name: dc-voice
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: voice follow mode and cleanup phase preview.

tokens.name: dc-idle
tokens.usage: Embed stripe: feature off or session not connected.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Entry screen headline. clamp(2.1rem, 5vw, 2.75rem) in the source: 44px at desktop, scales down to 34px.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Heading of a single-column card such as the sign-in card.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Entry screen summary. Keep under 65 characters a line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button, dock link, field label, setting description, toast.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, secondary row line, session badge, footer.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a list, between dock links, inside a pill track.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a group; dock padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar items; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's parts; field to field inside a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Space under a card header; setting row padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a stack; modal and mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Space above the dock; space under a modal body.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Side padding of the workspace and the entry screen.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Header side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Entry screen top block gap.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard shortcut tag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, shortcut key in the dock.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, rows, dock links, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, progress capsule, disclosure.

tokens.name: radius-dock

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, badges, pill nav, toggle, progress track.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: Entry sign-in button on hover (with a 1px lift).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toast.

tokens.name: shadow-menu

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: Dock pill.

tokens.name: shadow-float

tokens.name: z-dock
tokens.usage: Dock.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Row overflow menu.

tokens.name: z-progress
tokens.usage: Progress capsule.

tokens.name: z-modal

tokens.name: z-toast

tokens.name: z-skip
